title: Prediction platform Kalshi targets US oil market with perpetual WTI contract - The Economic Times
text:
Kalshi is preparing to seek US regulatory approval for a perpetual West Texas Intermediate crude oil futures contract, Reuters reported. The proposed 24/5 product would expand Kalshi’s derivatives business and could become the first oil-linked perpetual futures contract traded on a regulated US platform.
